facts.fact: Pritam took Kunal up the Kuhl ridge in autumn, a month after his father's funeral (beat wording). Kunal says his father died in spring of a lung fever. Revises F488's 'a week after the funeral'.
facts.why: needed because the beat says 'a month after his father died'; F488 and F526 say a week and a supper story, so the critic or S7 should reconcile.

facts.fact: The hill name for the crag Ila named Nimmi's Knuckle is the Widow's Knuckle, for the hand a widow laid on the rock while waiting for her husband.
facts.why: needed because Kunal's first free name had to be one he had withheld (F460).

facts.fact: Ila's queen's letter is now sewn in the lining of her pattu; a loosened stitch at the hem shows a corner of cream paper.
facts.why: needed because the beat shows the letter's corner in her pattu; F438 had it in her coat lining.

facts.fact: Ila and Kunal go to Dhanu's upper hut, a short climb above the shore where the Drum booms, for the night.
facts.why: needed because the beat sets the scene in the upper hut.

facts.fact: Ila has a white scar along one rib from a whipped-back survey chain.
facts.why: small intimate detail for the love scene.
